mapper.select: SELECT CD_VAL1 FROM TB_CMM_CODE WHERE GRP_CD = #{GRP_CD} AND CD = #{CD} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.update: MERGE INTO TB_CMM_CODE T USING (SELECT #{GRP_CD} AS GRP_CD, #{CD} AS CD FROM DUAL) S ON (T.GRP_CD = S.GRP_CD AND T.CD = S.CD) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET CD_NM = #{CD_NM}, CD_VAL1 = #{CD_VAL1}, CD_VAL2 = #{CD_VAL2}, SORT_ORD = NVL(#{SORT_ORD}, 0), USE_YN = NVL(#{USE_YN}, 'Y'), UPD_DT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (GRP_CD, CD, CD_NM, CD_VAL1, CD_VAL2, SORT_ORD, USE_YN, REG_DT) VALUES (#{GRP_CD}, #{CD}, #{CD_NM}, #{CD_VAL1}, #{CD_VAL2}, NVL(#{SORT_ORD}, 0), NVL(#{USE_YN}, 'Y'), SYSDATE)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_CMM_CODE WHERE GRP_CD = #{GRP_CD} AND CD = #{CD}
